editorial.blurb: La Minervha serves beautifully fresh sushi and seafood in a comfortable, vibrant space where excellent hospitality makes every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask for the tuna tostadas—reviewers can't stop raving about them, and they're the dish that keeps people coming back to Pilsen for this spot.
